_howTo: Practice videos on Vimeo (vimeo.com/precisiondental), shown as click-to-play cards (23 October 2026). Nothing loads from Vimeo until a visitor presses play. Groups: featured (homepage and Blog), invisalign (Invisalign page), veneers (Porcelain Veneers page), makeovers (Smile Gallery), library (the Dental Videos page, /dental-videos/, ordered by libraryOrder, filtered by category: Cosmetic, Invisalign, Implants, General, About Us). slug is the old website address of the video post, now redirected to the video on /dental-videos/. hidden: true keeps a video off the site. Patient videos have patient: true, which adds the AHPRA results disclaimer under the grid; confirm patient consent with the practice before launch. uploaded (the Vimeo upload date) feeds the VideoObject schema; the embed IDs were read from the old website posts on 26 October 2026.
disclaimer: Individual results may vary. Any surgical or invasive procedure carries risks. Before proceeding, you should seek a second opinion from an appropriately qualified health practitioner.

videos.title: Mark's Smile Makeover with Invisalign
videos.summary: Mark had two overlapping front teeth and chose Invisalign. Every treatment plan is different.

videos.title: Three Concerns Porcelain Veneers Can Address
videos.summary: Slightly uneven front teeth, tooth size and shape, and colour that whitening has not changed.

videos.title: 3 Causes of Toothache
videos.summary: Three common reasons a tooth starts to ache: decay that reaches the nerve, an abscess, and a gum infection around a wisdom tooth.

videos.title: How We Look After Anxious Patients
videos.summary: A first visit that can be a check-up only, extra time to talk, happy gas and headphones, and when sedation is worth discussing.

videos.title: The Porcelain Veneer Process, Step by Step
videos.summary: From digital smile design and a trial smile to preparing the teeth, temporary veneers and fitting the final veneers.

videos.title: Do Wisdom Teeth Always Need to Come Out?
videos.summary: Why many people keep their wisdom teeth, and the problems that can mean removal is recommended.

videos.title: The Dental Implant Process
videos.summary: Examination and 3D scans, placing the implant, a healing period, then the crown. Any surgical or invasive procedure carries risks.

videos.title: Early Signs of Tooth Decay
videos.summary: Sensitivity to hot and cold, a hole or dark spot, and bad breath: signs it is time for a check-up.

videos.title: What Can Invisalign Help With?
videos.summary: Crowded teeth, gaps, and evening out teeth before other cosmetic treatment.

videos.title: Why Dental Fees Differ Between Practices
videos.summary: What goes into a fee: materials and equipment, the time spent planning and treating, and the clinician’s experience.

videos.title: What Happens at Your First Consultation
videos.summary: Your history and concerns, an examination and X-rays, then a plan with fees so you can decide before any treatment.

videos.title: 3 Things That Make Precision Dental Different
videos.summary: Dr Choi talks about patient comfort, being upfront about treatment, and the materials the practice uses.
